name: goldener-research
description: Local skills and plugins for the goldener-research repo.

plugins.name: sync-idea-issues
plugins.description: Sync GitHub issues labeled "idea" into the matching topic IDEAS.md file, then branch, commit, push, open a PR, and close the source issues.

plugins.name: sync-researcher-issues
plugins.description: Research GitHub issues labeled "researcher", find relevant papers, then branch, commit, push, open a PR adding them to the matching topic RESEARCHERS.md file(s), and close the source issues.
